terms.gloss: any minute now, at this very moment
evidence: Cic. Att. 7.20.1: at illum ruere nūntiant et jam jamque adesse (Lewis & Short s.v. jam)
terms.comment: The doubled jam says that a thing is on the point of happening: jam jamque videō bellum, I can see war coming any moment (Cic. Att. 16.9).

sources: Lewis & Short: jam
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 346.
